messages:
Rhea (CSM): FYI Wavefront onboarding spiked embeddings overnight. Renewal in ~5 weeks. Need a 7-day spend projection + a short QBR note we can show them.
Tomo (FinOps): grabbing numbers. Do we know baseline and peak?
Eli (Onboard): baseline ~600k tokens/day. Last night hit 3.9M after a dataset import. Embeddings ~78% of tokens.
Harper (AE): customer stressed about unexpected charges. Wants a firm cap option in the renewal discussion.
Rhea (CSM): plan: 1) quick forecast with two scenarios 2) short-term guardrails we can apply now 3) crisp customer messaging for QBR.
billing-bot: Alert: Wavefront projected to reach 60% of monthly credit in 4 days at current trend.
Tomo (FinOps): Using hosted standard pricing $0.0008/1k tokens. Scenario 1 (no mitigation): ~ $5.2k incremental cost over 7 days. Scenario 2 (throttle + dedupe cache): ~ $1.4k.
Eli (Onboard): I can push per-route rate limits and enable embedding dedupe cache. Quick config I'll use: route=/v1/embeddings rate_limit=220rpm burst=45 cache=true cache_ttl=86400
Harper (AE): propose offering a one-time onboarding credit $1k and set soft alert at 60%, hard cap at 85%. Finance sign-off needed.
Rhea (CSM): suggested customer nudge: "We spotted a high-volume import and applied temporary throttling plus an onboarding credit to avoid bill shock. We'll review usage and recommended guardrails at your QBR."
Tomo (FinOps): I'll add two slides to the deck (baseline vs mitigated) and request credit approval. Need final numbers by EOD.
Eli (Onboard): limits applied; throughput down ~68% and token burn trending downward.
billing-bot: Notice: soft threshold (60%) projected in 3 days if trend continues.
Rhea (CSM): action list: @Tomo finalize deck figures, @Eli keep monitoring and log config to enablement playbook, @Harper confirm credit approval. I'll draft the QBR blurb and send for review.
Harper (AE): will follow up with finance now.
Rhea (CSM): thanks team, closing thread for now.
